name: opendash
description: An open-source SimHub dashboard generated from TypeScript and design tokens, with a plugin that installs it and exposes its settings.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/generator/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dash/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/tsconfig.json
